review_candidates.title: Edge Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: ALL CVs MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH FOR CONSIDERATION. Overview: We are looking for a highly experienced Edge Network Engineer to lead complex edge, network, and cloud platform deployments. This role will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert during onboarding, migrations, and new platform integrations. Success in this role requires exceptional technical knowledge, strong communication skills, and the ability to lead both technical workstreams and customer expectations. The Edge Network Engineer position provides customer facing network design, implementation, configuration standardization as it relates to network routing protocols, switching and security methodology. As part of the Edge Network Engineering team, this role also serves as a Tier 4 escalation point from the global support organization. Experience with SD-WAN—especially Versa Networks—is a major asset and will elevate your candidacy. Key Responsibilities: Lead customer deployments of edge computing infrastructure, cloud integration, and SD-WAN platforms. Act as the technical point of contact for end-to-end implementation activities, including architecture planning, configuration, testing, and go-live support. Work closely with project managers, systems engineers, and customer stakeholders to align on design and timelines. Troubleshoot deployment issues across operating systems, hypervisors, containers, and networks. Develop automation scripts and reusable tooling to improve speed and consistency of deployments within the larger context of the company strategy. Document procedures, configurations, and lessons learned; contribute to internal knowledge bases. Mentor junior engineers and participate in internal enablement and cross-functional collaboration. Participate in periodic customer workshops to review implementation design as needed to support large-scale or complex rollouts. Qualifications: Extensive experience in Linux system administration and troubleshooting. Proficiency with Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors (e.g., KVM, VMware). Familiarity with containerization technologies; experience with lightweight Kubernetes distributions (e.g., K3s) preferred. Strong understanding of networking principles including routing, VLANs, firewalls, DNS, NAT, Routing protocols and proxies. Hands-on experience configuring and managing network interfaces, both physical and virtual. Prior experience with SD-WAN deployment and management; Versa SD-WAN experience is a strong plus. Proficiency in using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, iptables, netstat, and other network diagnostic utilities. Experience with cloud service providers such as Azure or AWS, including VM provisioning, datastore configuration, and SSO setup. Comfortable working with REST APIs and using tools like Postman, Swagger, curl, and Python scripts for automation and testing. Awareness of secure deployment principles; familiarity with TPM, encryption, and measured boot is a plus (can be trained internally). Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Bash scripting. Experience with tools like ServiceNow, Jira, or other ITSM platforms for Project/Change/Incident management. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly document issues, escalate appropriately, and collaborate across teams. Fluent in English Preferred Background: 5+ years in edge infrastructure deployment, implementation engineering, or similar technical field. Experience supporting or deploying edge orchestration platforms (e.g., Zededa, Azure IoT Edge, AWS Greengrass). Experience with zero-touch provisioning, telemetry pipelines, or site/network architecture at the edge is a plus. Why Join Us? Work at the cutting edge of network operations, edge computing/networking, and satellite systems, enabling global connectivity in the most remote and demanding scenarios. Be part of a collaborative, fast-moving team that values technical depth, mentorship, and continuous learning. Working at Speedcast: At Speedcast, we want people that like adventure. Who are motivated by work that takes uncommon ingenuity and thinking outside the box. Who relish the idea of working in an industry undergoing massive transformation. If you want to be part of a global team responsible for connecting the world, then you’re in the right place. We're always pushing forward, never standing still. When people rely on you and your team to stay connected, it brings everyone closer together. We’re united by the adrenaline of high-stakes projects and our love of getting the job done right. You will experiment, learn and grow here, right alongside us, every single day. Find great opportunities to make an impact. We have a "one team, one dream" mentality. We work together to make great things happen. Working at Speedcast isn't just a job, it's a career that you can take to new levels. Top reasons why people love working at Speedcast: Our global presence – you get to work with clients and colleagues all over the world, in every continent Talented teammates – your co-workers are the best and brightest in the industry Industry leadership – be part of the latest advancements shaping the future of communications Ability to develop skills – work across departments to gain new skills and valuable experience Choose your environment – we have an environment to fit your temperament. Choose between a traditional desk job or work in the field. Grow your career - Guide your career in the direction you want. Gain new titles and responsibilities through our internal promotion system. Work on diverse projects – every day is different with our customers from a range of industries around the world Speedcast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. The US EEO is the Law poster is available by visiting the below link: https://www.eeoc.gov/employers/upload/poster_screen_reader_optimized.pdf Speedcast does not accept or retain unsolicited résumés or phone calls and/or respond to them or to any third party representing job seekers.

Predominantly focused in the transport domain, typical tasks and responsibilities include: Implementing processes to capture, manage, validate and measure the quality of systems engineering outputs and deliverables e.g. requirements. Working closely with Stakeholders to elicit requirements, ensuring the resulting requirements are clear, concise, demonstratable, unambiguous and achievable. Work with projects to ensure robust evidence for the validation and verification of Requirements. Implementing systems, processes and using industry standard tools (e.g. DOORS, Visio, Enterprise Architect) and process (e.g. Architecting) to support integration, requirements and V&V. Maintaining and developing competence in line with our systems engineering competence framework Establishing and maintaining relationships with external parties (e.g. INCOSE/IfSE, SaRS) and clients (e.g. Network Rail, HS2, Heathrow Airport Ltd) to enhance the company reputation. Profile/Skills Essential Requirements For The Role Include The suitable candidate will have proven and broad-ranging experience coupled with commercial acumen and a desire to learn and develop in their Systems Engineering understanding within an established design consultancy. Thus, we are looking for someone with the following knowledge and experience: Experience working in Requirements Management, DOORS, and document control on projects Experience with large-scale infrastructure projects Previous experience in the UK rail industry with respect to Systems Engineering application to turnkey mainline or mass transit railway projects Knowledge of systems engineering concepts and processes, including project lifecycle delivery and applicable standards. Desirable Requirements For The Role Include Experience of ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 and ISO/IEC42010 Experience of DOORS Requirements Management Databases Experience of configuration management methods/tools Experience of undertaking verification, validation and system assurance activities on lmajor infrastructure programmes

review_candidates.title: Sr. Project Engineer - High Voltage Transmission Line Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: Position: Sr. Project Engineer, high-voltage transmission infrastructure Location: Greater Chicago OR Sacramento area Reports to: Managing Director of Engineering & Construction Company: Private equity-backed operator of high-voltage transmission infrastructure Chamberlain Advisors is conducting an executive search for a Senior Project Engineer on behalf of our direct client, a scaling private equity-backed operator of high-voltage transmission infrastructure. As an integral member of the Engineering & Construction team, this individual will lead and manage the design of assigned high-voltage transmission line and/or substation projects from conception through construction and energization. This role is vital for winning competitive FERC Order 1000 bids and ensuring efficient project construction. They are seeking an individual with a balance of Project Management skills and technical competency in either transmission line or substation engineering disciplines, or ideally both, demonstrating experience in full life cycle management of high voltage (>100kV) transmission facility projects. The ideal candidate will have a bias for action, proven analytical and problem-solving skills, while ensuring project commercial and technical targets are met or exceeded. The ideal candidate must be technically astute, collaborative, and possess a strong entrepreneurial spirit, willing to adapt and lead in a fast-paced, highly interactive team setting to deliver successful outcomes. This is an extraordinary opportunity for an engineering leader to provide strategic technical and project leadership in a dynamic, high-growth environment. Core Selection Criteria: alignment with some or all of the following criteria is highly desired: Entrepreneurial Spirit: The ideal candidate thrives in building and growing a business, taking full ownership of its success. With a strong continuous improvement mindset and a hands-on approach, they excel at driving rapid, effective results. A self-starter, the candidate is comfortable transitioning from high-level strategy to day-to-day operations, digging into the details when necessary. Motivated by the opportunity to be autonomous, lead transformative change, they are energized by solving visible, impactful problems and working in a lean, private equity-backed environment. This individual is gritty, willing to get their hands dirty, and committed to building and growing the company’s success, without relying heavily on extensive support layers. High-voltage Technical Design & Engineering Expertise: This encompasses deep knowledge and hands-on experience in either transmission line or substation design, specifically at high-voltages (100 kV as a floor, ideally 230 kV or 345 kV and above). The candidate must demonstrate proficiency in utilizing industry-standard design tools prevalent within the high-voltage transmission sector, including but not limited to PLS-CADD, SAG10, AutoCAD, or other similar tools. The ideal candidate will have been accountable for the entire design lifecycle, leading the project and bringing all elements together, beyond siloed tasks such as electrical studies. You will have navigated the complexities of greenfield transmission line projects including routing through diverse terrains, securing environmental permits, and optimizing cost-efficiency. Experience with complex elements like underground transmission, mountainous terrain, or HVDC (LCC or VSC) is a strong plus. FERC Order 1000 Proposals: You will lead the technical engineering effort for competitive FERC Order 1000 RFPs, strategically developing and evaluating solutions for cost-effectiveness across various ISO requirements. This includes creating comprehensive engineering deliverables and advocating for your proposed solutions to stakeholders. Your strong understanding and application of quality review processes for all engineering documentation are essential. Given the fast-paced and iterative nature of these proposals, you must be comfortable with constant team interaction, frequent meetings, and adapting quickly to changes and rework. While direct FERC Order 1000 experience is beneficial, a proven track record in any complex proposal or bid response is sufficient. Strategic Third-Party Management & Diverse Project Leadership: You are adept at effectively managing, influencing, and driving accountability through external consulting firms, guiding and partnering with them to achieve project success by fostering truly collaborative relationships. Your technical expertise must be at least equivalent to that of the consultants you manage, enabling you to ask informed questions and keep project processes on track. We seek a technical project engineer who can also perform holistic project management, taking accountability for schedule, cost aspects/budgets, and assembling/reviewing inputs for estimates, as well as the oversight/technical management of schedules, timelines, and work of your consultants/teams. Multi-Stakeholder Management & Collaborative Leadership: You excel at managing and influencing diverse internal and external stakeholders, including third-party engineering consultants, construction partners, OEMs, and regulatory bodies. Your approach fosters strong, productive partnerships, ensuring all parties are aligned with project goals and deliverables. You are adept at guiding and empowering external partners, leveraging your technical insight to ensure work aligns with scope, budget, and quality standards. This includes the ability to convey complex technical details to non-technical stakeholders and management, facilitating clear communication and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.. What You Will Be Accountable For Proposal Phase (Winning Projects): Work within the Engineering team to ensure designs are aligned with the overall proposal strategy of their Development Group. Projects generally begin as FERC 1,000 competitive transmission project proposals but may also involve acquisitions of existing utility assets Lead the technical engineering effort to support competitive proposal teams, specifically focusing on responses to FERC Order 1000 RFPs. This includes navigating the unique requirements of various ISOs (e.g., CAISO, NYISO, MISO, PJM). Competitively bid and secure engineering and third-party consulting resources required to adequately support the development team’s proposal efforts and RFP specific requirements. Manage and guide third-party engineering consultants, ensuring their work aligns with project scope, budget, and quality standards, and strategically determining necessary reports (e.g., desk study & preliminary geotechnical assessments) to optimize proposal development. Directly supervise the selected consultant in developing conceptual designs (design criteria and related design documentation) that will form the basis of the development team’s proposal and project estimate, providing guidance and feedback on designs within a competitive transmission framework. Lead the coordination with OEM (HVDC systems, HVAC equipment, conductors, cables, etc.) and ensure the technical and commercial requirements are in line with project requirements and internal strategy expectations. Rapidly screen and evaluate diverse technical solutions for cost-effectiveness, applying strong engineering judgment to identify the most viable and competitive options. Develop comprehensive engineering deliverables for proposals, such as preliminary structural drawings, detailed electrical studies, and foundation designs. Prepare robust estimating packages to facilitate collaboration with external construction partners, ensuring alignment between design and cost projections. Manage all contracted resources to meet deliverable dates and complete tasks within budget. Adapt quickly to iterative changes and tight deadlines inherent in competitive bidding processes, which often compress traditional engineering phases into shorter, parallel workflows. Act as a technical advocate during proposal phase, articulating the value and superiority of their proposed solutions to regulatory bodies and stakeholders. Execution Phase (Completing Construction Projects) Following award of a project, develop RFP and technical scope documents for all procurement related to engineering and constructing the awarded project (e.g., engineering consulting services, 3rd party services, high voltage equipment, transmission line structures and materials, construction contracts, etc.). Lead the bid evaluation process for both technical and commercial aspects of supplier’s proposal. Take full accountability for both the project management and technical aspects of projects, including managing scope, schedule, and budget. This includes the ability to convey complex technical details to non-technical stakeholders and management. review_candidates.title: Site Reliability Engineering Technical Lead
review_candidates.description: Sustainability that means business Who We Are Sustainability software specialist, AMCS, is headquartered in Ireland, with offices in Europe, the USA, and Australasia. With over 1,300 highly-skilled employees across 22 countries, we specialize in delivering technology solutions to facilitate a carbon neutral future. What We Do Our innovative SaaS solutions increase efficiency and boost sustainability in resource-intensive industries. Over 5,000 customers across 23 countries already benefit from our Performance Sustainability software, ensuring we deliver practical solutions for improved profitability and environmental resilience across the globe. Our people AMCS offers team members more than just a job, but an opportunity to map out a career with a company that is growing, evolving and setting out new ways of working that are having a positive impact on the world around us. AMCS was established in Ireland and holds onto those local roots and ‘start-up’ mentality with a culture of connection. Connection to our work, our customers, our colleagues and our community that creates a working environment that fosters openness, collaboration and creativity. Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps/SRE Tech Lead to join our dynamic engineering team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of cloud technologies, a strong technical background and a passion for driving operational excellence. As a Tech Lead, you will not only mentor and guide our DevOps engineers but also participate in architectural and key decision-making forums regarding our infrastructure and application development processes ensuring a focus is always on the reliability of our systems and centered on positive customer experience. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of our systems and infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Build SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs: Partner with development and business teams to define indicators and objectives that reflect real customer experience Incident Response: Lead through complex incidents and continuously improve how quickly we detect, diagnose, and resolve issues — sharpening alerting, tooling, and on-call practices to shorten MTTD and MTTR over time. Evolve Monitoring and Observability Stack: Consistently improve the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) with a customer-centric lens leading our operations to be more effective Drive RCAs and Postmortems: Run blameless root cause analyses and postmortems that turn incidents into durable improvements, closing the developer and operations loop High Availability & Performance: Ensure platform availability and responsiveness meet customer expectations. Identify and remove performance bottlenecks before they impact customer AI for Operations: Apply AI/LLM capabilities to incident triage, log/trace analysis, runbook execution, and anomaly detection to shorten MTTR and reduce on-call load. Optimization for Cost: Right-size workloads, eliminate waste, and design for cost-efficient scaling across our cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and container infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes). Toil Reduction: Build automated processes to reduce toil within SRE, such as remediation for known failure modes so the platform heals itself where possible, escalating to humans only when judgement is genuinely required. Architectural Oversight: Participate in architectural design and decision-making processes, ensuring that design choices align with organizational goals and best practices. What Success Looks Like High-Signal Alerting: Alerts are accurate and actionable — when something fires, it matters, and the team trusts it. Noise is actively driven down rather than tolerated. Fewer Production Incidents: The number and severity of customer-impacting incidents trend down over time, as recurring failure modes are addressed at the root rather than worked around. Tight Product–SRE Feedback Loop: Continuous, two-way feedback between product engineering and SRE — reliability concerns shape what gets built, and operational learnings flow back into product decisions. Reduced Toil: Engineers spend less time on repetitive operational work and more time on improvements that compound — measured by what gets automated, eliminated, or self-healed away. Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Experience:5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or related fields, with at least 2 years in a leadership or mentoring role. Cloud Technologies: Deep understanding of cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP) and hands-on experience with cloud architecture. Architectural Design: Proven experience in providing architectural oversight, with a strong ability to make informed decisions that drive system performance and scalability. Containerization: Proven experience with container orchestration platforms, particularly Kubernetes. Scripting: Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python or Bash. Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and the Grafana stack. Automation Tools: Experience with automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Chef. Soft Skills: Strong leadership qualities, excellent communication skills, and a collaborative mindset. Preferred Qualifications Experience with CI/CD pipelines and relevant tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.). Kubernetes certification (CKA, CKAD) and/or cloud certifications (Azure, AWS, GCP) are highly desirable. Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards in cloud environments. Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools.

review_candidates.description: Who We Are: Some of the companies under our stable include Private Equity (licensed by the Securities Commission), Digital Marketing, Recruitment, Esports, Event Management and Consultancy. We care about understanding things for what they are, and not what they appear to be. We know we will not always make the right decisions, but we put in the effort to make our decisions right. We value people who are curious, disciplined, and open to learning. We care about doing things properly, even when it takes time. Our companies follow the same principle: practical, thoughtful, and built for people who appreciate steady, honest work. Role Overview: You will own the numbers across a portfolio of companies operating in Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia, and you will lead a finance team of seven. This is a build role before it is a maintenance role. The team is new. The systems are not yet in place. Your first year is about putting them there: one standard chart of accounts across every entity, a close calendar that actually holds, a review process that catches errors before they travel upward, and consolidated numbers that arrive on time and can be relied upon. If you are looking for a seat where the structure already exists and the job is to keep it running, this is not that role. If you have wanted to design a finance function properly rather than inherit somebody else's compromises, and you are comfortable working in ambiguity while you do it, this is that role. You will report directly to our CEO, with nobody in between. Your Team: You will have a team of seven: three Senior Finance Executives, two Finance Executives, and two interns. This being a new role in an expanding organization, 4 of your reports arrive without a long track record. Teaching is therefore not a side duty in this role. It is half of it. What You Will Do: 1) Team leadership and technical development. Lead, teach and develop a team of seven across three levels of experience. Review your team's work technically, not only for completeness. You are the reason errors stop travelling upward. Build the training path that takes fresh graduates and interns to competence, and set the standard for documentation, self-checking and knowing when to escalate versus when to decide. 2) Financial reporting, close and consolidation. Own timely and accurate monthly and annual closings across your portfolio of entities. Deliver consolidation and management accounts, including intercompany eliminations and a documented shared-services allocation methodology. Build and hold a close calendar with named owners and committed dates, and design a documented, repeatable consolidation process. 3) Financial operations and internal controls. Manage daily finance operations including treasury, banking, working capital and cash visibility. This full in-house setup is what lets us move fast and control quality end to end, from the first creative idea to the final ad running on Meta or TikTok. Short Agency is now expanding into the UAE. This is the same agency you know from France, launching its Emirati branch, built to bring the same performance video model to the Emirates market, with the cultural and creative adaptations that market requires. The team here is being built from the ground up, and the Project Manager we're hiring will be one of the very first people on the ground, working directly with Mathis Faivre (Short Agency Group) and Clément Vannier, General Manager of Short Agency in the UAE. This isn't a role inside an established structure, it's a chance to help build one, in a market with major upside and few serious operators doing what we do. Must-haves This role is not open to junior profiles. To be considered, you need: Real shoot management experience. You have already run productions end to end, not only attended them An advertising agency background. Minimum 3 years in an advertising or creative agency, and 5 years or more is what we're really aiming for Fluent French and English. Both are required, you will work daily in both languages. Arabic is a plus, but absolutely not mandatory Very strong command of social media. Formats, codes, platform mechanics, what performs and why, on Meta and TikTok above all. We're not asking you to create content yourself: we're asking you to be able to judge it, discuss it with a client and steer the creative team Complete ease with technical shoot crews. Camera, sound, lighting, editors, you speak their language and you can hold your ground on a set Based in Dubai. We're not hiring remotely and relocating afterwards, you're already here The role The Project Manager owns the full client relationship, end to end. You are the client's main point of contact, they should always know exactly who to call. The accounts you'll handle are not small ones. We're building this branch to work with established local companies and large brands, with the level of expectation, structure and stakes that comes with them. We need someone who understands what's at play on that kind of account: budget, brand image, internal decision chains, and delivery that has to be right the first time. Your core responsibilities: Ensure client satisfaction Run projects and their execution Coordinate internal teams Organize shoots and productions Grow existing accounts You are accountable for the success of every account you manage, both the operational delivery and the relationship. This is an orchestration role, not a creative production one. You don't make the content yourself: you run the machine that makes it, with the creative, production and editing teams, and you're the person the client talks to. 1. Client account management and project delivery Run client kick offs Understand each client's marketing and business objectives, and the business model behind them Frame expectations and scope, and hold that scope through the project Maintain clear, regular communication at the right level, including with senior stakeholders and decision makers Anticipate needs and issues before they surface Respond quickly to client requests Manage tension or misunderstandings when they arise, and handle difficult conversations yourself Coordinate internal teams (creative, production, editing) Plan project phases and track progress Guarantee deadlines are met Centralize and manage client feedback Make sure information flows correctly between teams Goal: smooth project execution and a flawless client relationship, on accounts where mistakes are expensive. 2. Shoot organization Define production needs for each project Coordinate internal and external teams Organize shoots with the production team Build shoot roadmaps Check everything is ready before filming Brief field teams and technical crews Anticipate logistical constraints, including permits, locations and local regulations in the UAE Handle shoot day surprises and make the call on the spot Track production follow through The role requires being reactive to the unexpected, including handling urgent situations outside normal hours, and managing fast back and forth between clients, the team, and talent or actors when needed. Goal: organized, smooth, reliable shoots, at a scale and a quality level that stands up in front of large clients. 3. Performance analysis Analyze video and campaign performance Identify what's working Identify areas for improvement Suggest optimizations Understand each client's marketing stakes Training available on ad platforms (Meta Business Manager) Goal: bring real strategic value and improve campaign performance. 4. Strategic recommendations Spot growth opportunities within accounts Propose new concepts or formats Prepare creative recommendations and defend them in front of the client Support clients in their marketing decisions Prepare review calls Anticipate upcoming campaigns Goal: turn collaborations into long term partnerships. 5. Client re engagement Spot re engagement opportunities Prepare review calls Propose new collaborations Work hand in hand with the sales team Track re engagement pipeline opportunities Keep the CRM updated Goal: increase client LTV and grow existing accounts. 6. Administrative and financial follow up Track client payments Check invoicing on projects Track vendor and freelancer payments Flag delays or anomalies Goal: clear financial tracking across collaborations. 7. Process building Suggest organizational improvements Structure work templates Improve project management methods Document best practices Help structure internal tools Goal: continuously improve how the project management team operates, and help define what good looks like in a brand new market. 8. What this role demands This is not a quiet role. We're looking for someone who is highly involved, extremely organized, able to run multiple projects in parallel, comfortable in a fast and demanding environment, and able to handle the unexpected. The role requires strong autonomy, high responsiveness, and real ownership of client accounts. Given the seniority we're looking for, we expect you to make decisions on your own rather than escalate everything, and to set the standard for the people who join after you. Short Agency's UAE launch is a fast growing new venture, and we're looking for people who want to build something, grow fast, and take on real responsibility as the market and the team scale. 9. Growth path Being one of Short Agency's first UAE hires means real upside as the structure grows: a fast track toward becoming a direct point of contact for key accounts, and longer term, a potential path toward a Head of Production role for the UAE market. We're looking for people who want to grow with the venture and take on meaningful responsibility over the next few years. 10. Terms and compensation This is an in-house role , as a full member of the Short Agency UAE team. Offices in Dubai Design District (d3). The role is hybrid: office days as a team, with the possibility of working remotely the rest of the time. Based in Dubai , required. Compensation is discussed, not fixed in advance. There is no salary grid and no pay parity across the team: what we offer depends entirely on the profile, the experience and the scope each person takes on. The package is worked out directly with the selected candidate during the final interview. 11. How to apply Applications go through one short form, and that is the only way in. We do not review CVs sent by email or profiles sent by private message: if the form has not been filled in, the application is not considered. It takes about five minutes, plus a two-minute video at the end. We use it to qualify every candidate against the same criteria, so the shortlist is built on what people have actually done rather than on who wrote the nicest message. We get back to everyone.

Wir entwickeln, fertigen und warten Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Systeme in allen Bereichen der militärischen Verteidigung und der zivilen Sicherheit. In Nürnberg sind wir im Bereich EW auf Airborne Radar Electronic Support Measures (R-ESM), Electronic Countermeasure (ECM), Communications Intelligence (COMINT), Communications Electronic Support Measures (C-ESM) und auf die Fusion von Daten verschiedener Sensoren spezialisiert. new_matches.description: Position: Sr. Project Engineer, high-voltage transmission infrastructure Location: Greater Chicago OR Sacramento area Reports to: Managing Director of Engineering & Construction Company: Private equity-backed operator of high-voltage transmission infrastructure Chamberlain Advisors is conducting an executive search for a Senior Project Engineer on behalf of our direct client, a scaling private equity-backed operator of high-voltage transmission infrastructure. As an integral member of the Engineering & Construction team, this individual will lead and manage the design of assigned high-voltage transmission line and/or substation projects from conception through construction and energization. This role is vital for winning competitive FERC Order 1000 bids and ensuring efficient project construction. They are seeking an individual with a balance of Project Management skills and technical competency in either transmission line or substation engineering disciplines, or ideally both, demonstrating experience in full life cycle management of high voltage (>100kV) transmission facility projects. The ideal candidate will have a bias for action, proven analytical and problem-solving skills, while ensuring project commercial and technical targets are met or exceeded. The ideal candidate must be technically astute, collaborative, and possess a strong entrepreneurial spirit, willing to adapt and lead in a fast-paced, highly interactive team setting to deliver successful outcomes. This is an extraordinary opportunity for an engineering leader to provide strategic technical and project leadership in a dynamic, high-growth environment. Core Selection Criteria: alignment with some or all of the following criteria is highly desired: Entrepreneurial Spirit: The ideal candidate thrives in building and growing a business, taking full ownership of its success. With a strong continuous improvement mindset and a hands-on approach, they excel at driving rapid, effective results. A self-starter, the candidate is comfortable transitioning from high-level strategy to day-to-day operations, digging into the details when necessary. Motivated by the opportunity to be autonomous, lead transformative change, they are energized by solving visible, impactful problems and working in a lean, private equity-backed environment. This individual is gritty, willing to get their hands dirty, and committed to building and growing the company’s success, without relying heavily on extensive support layers. High-voltage Technical Design & Engineering Expertise: This encompasses deep knowledge and hands-on experience in either transmission line or substation design, specifically at high-voltages (100 kV as a floor, ideally 230 kV or 345 kV and above). The candidate must demonstrate proficiency in utilizing industry-standard design tools prevalent within the high-voltage transmission sector, including but not limited to PLS-CADD, SAG10, AutoCAD, or other similar tools. The ideal candidate will have been accountable for the entire design lifecycle, leading the project and bringing all elements together, beyond siloed tasks such as electrical studies. You will have navigated the complexities of greenfield transmission line projects including routing through diverse terrains, securing environmental permits, and optimizing cost-efficiency. Experience with complex elements like underground transmission, mountainous terrain, or HVDC (LCC or VSC) is a strong plus. FERC Order 1000 Proposals: You will lead the technical engineering effort for competitive FERC Order 1000 RFPs, strategically developing and evaluating solutions for cost-effectiveness across various ISO requirements. This includes creating comprehensive engineering deliverables and advocating for your proposed solutions to stakeholders. Your strong understanding and application of quality review processes for all engineering documentation are essential. Given the fast-paced and iterative nature of these proposals, you must be comfortable with constant team interaction, frequent meetings, and adapting quickly to changes and rework. While direct FERC Order 1000 experience is beneficial, a proven track record in any complex proposal or bid response is sufficient. Strategic Third-Party Management & Diverse Project Leadership: You are adept at effectively managing, influencing, and driving accountability through external consulting firms, guiding and partnering with them to achieve project success by fostering truly collaborative relationships. Your technical expertise must be at least equivalent to that of the consultants you manage, enabling you to ask informed questions and keep project processes on track. We seek a technical project engineer who can also perform holistic project management, taking accountability for schedule, cost aspects/budgets, and assembling/reviewing inputs for estimates, as well as the oversight/technical management of schedules, timelines, and work of your consultants/teams. Multi-Stakeholder Management & Collaborative Leadership: You excel at managing and influencing diverse internal and external stakeholders, including third-party engineering consultants, construction partners, OEMs, and regulatory bodies. Your approach fosters strong, productive partnerships, ensuring all parties are aligned with project goals and deliverables. You are adept at guiding and empowering external partners, leveraging your technical insight to ensure work aligns with scope, budget, and quality standards. This includes the ability to convey complex technical details to non-technical stakeholders and management, facilitating clear communication and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.. What You Will Be Accountable For Proposal Phase (Winning Projects): Work within the Engineering team to ensure designs are aligned with the overall proposal strategy of their Development Group. Projects generally begin as FERC 1,000 competitive transmission project proposals but may also involve acquisitions of existing utility assets Lead the technical engineering effort to support competitive proposal teams, specifically focusing on responses to FERC Order 1000 RFPs. This includes navigating the unique requirements of various ISOs (e.g., CAISO, NYISO, MISO, PJM). Competitively bid and secure engineering and third-party consulting resources required to adequately support the development team’s proposal efforts and RFP specific requirements. Manage and guide third-party engineering consultants, ensuring their work aligns with project scope, budget, and quality standards, and strategically determining necessary reports (e.g., desk study & preliminary geotechnical assessments) to optimize proposal development. Directly supervise the selected consultant in developing conceptual designs (design criteria and related design documentation) that will form the basis of the development team’s proposal and project estimate, providing guidance and feedback on designs within a competitive transmission framework. Lead the coordination with OEM (HVDC systems, HVAC equipment, conductors, cables, etc.) and ensure the technical and commercial requirements are in line with project requirements and internal strategy expectations. Rapidly screen and evaluate diverse technical solutions for cost-effectiveness, applying strong engineering judgment to identify the most viable and competitive options. Develop comprehensive engineering deliverables for proposals, such as preliminary structural drawings, detailed electrical studies, and foundation designs. Prepare robust estimating packages to facilitate collaboration with external construction partners, ensuring alignment between design and cost projections. Manage all contracted resources to meet deliverable dates and complete tasks within budget. Adapt quickly to iterative changes and tight deadlines inherent in competitive bidding processes, which often compress traditional engineering phases into shorter, parallel workflows. Act as a technical advocate during proposal phase, articulating the value and superiority of their proposed solutions to regulatory bodies and stakeholders. Execution Phase (Completing Construction Projects) Following award of a project, develop RFP and technical scope documents for all procurement related to engineering and constructing the awarded project (e.g., engineering consulting services, 3rd party services, high voltage equipment, transmission line structures and materials, construction contracts, etc.). Lead the bid evaluation process for both technical and commercial aspects of supplier’s proposal. Take full accountability for both the project management and technical aspects of projects, including managing scope, schedule, and budget. This includes the ability to convey complex technical details to non-technical stakeholders and management. Provide ongoing management and guidance to external engineering consultants throughout the project lifecycle, serving as the primary technical interface and ensuring their deliverables meet specifications and timelines. The candidate will be responsible for directing consultant’s activities, conducting design reviews/optimizing designs, developing the project specific design requirements document, interpreting and applying code requirements, and managing all work to the prescribed deadlines. Develop, review, and approve engineering deliverables (drawings, specifications, BOMs, design reports), ensuring all work complies with applicable codes, standards, safety, and operating requirements. Implement and champion robust quality review processes for all engineering documentation and drawings, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to industry standards and best practices. Perform technical risk assessments and actively resolve design challenges in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. Closely coordinate with other project stakeholders to identify and develop a transmission line route and/or substation site and provide technical inputs to obtain permits necessary to design and develop the project. Oversee the engineering and technical integrity of awarded projects, ensuring designs are accurately translated into constructible plans. Manage project progress comprehensively, from initial design through construction oversight, commissioning, and ultimately, hand-off to operations and maintenance. Coordinate with other groups inside and outside of the company to ensure the projects are successful and aligned with their strategic business objectives. Generally responsible for providing a single E&C project point of contact and owner’s engineer for both internal and external personnel and groups on assigned projects, including presentations/briefing on current progress (e.g. technical, cost, schedule), issues, procurement concerns/strategy, construction planning, and risk mitigation in meetings with other company personnel. Foster a highly collaborative working environment, actively participating in frequent team meetings and maintaining continuous communication with internal and external project stakeholders. What Qualifications You Need Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Engineering Technology required; Master's preferred. Professional Engineer (PE) license highly preferred. PMP or Six Sigma Certification is beneficial. Proven career progression, preferably with 5-10 years at prior companies, showcasing diverse experience across utilities, consulting, or manufactures of HVDC components. Minimum 7 years direct experience in high-voltage (>100kV) transmission line (>5 Miles) or substation project development, design, engineering, and construction. Ideally 2+ years' experience developing designs for FERC Order 1000 proposals, or broader experience in competitive bid/proposal work. Proficient using an industry-standard transmission design software such as (PLS-CADD, SAG10), and/or electric substation design tools such as (AutoCAD Electrical, Bentley’s Open Utilities Substation). Proficient using a project management tool such as (MS Project, Primavera). Understanding of procurement, construction planning, Critical Path Scheduling, and Cost Estimating for HV transmission projects. Knowledge of HVDC technology (LCC or VSC) is a plus. Adaptability to dynamic, fast-paced environments with evolving solutions and tight deadlines. Strong communication and collaborative skills for constant internal and external interaction.

new_matches.title: Site Reliability Engineering Technical Lead
new_matches.description: Sustainability that means business Who We Are Sustainability software specialist, AMCS, is headquartered in Ireland, with offices in Europe, the USA, and Australasia. With over 1,300 highly-skilled employees across 22 countries, we specialize in delivering technology solutions to facilitate a carbon neutral future. What We Do Our innovative SaaS solutions increase efficiency and boost sustainability in resource-intensive industries. Over 5,000 customers across 23 countries already benefit from our Performance Sustainability software, ensuring we deliver practical solutions for improved profitability and environmental resilience across the globe. Our people AMCS offers team members more than just a job, but an opportunity to map out a career with a company that is growing, evolving and setting out new ways of working that are having a positive impact on the world around us. AMCS was established in Ireland and holds onto those local roots and ‘start-up’ mentality with a culture of connection. Connection to our work, our customers, our colleagues and our community that creates a working environment that fosters openness, collaboration and creativity. Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps/SRE Tech Lead to join our dynamic engineering team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of cloud technologies, a strong technical background and a passion for driving operational excellence. As a Tech Lead, you will not only mentor and guide our DevOps engineers but also participate in architectural and key decision-making forums regarding our infrastructure and application development processes ensuring a focus is always on the reliability of our systems and centered on positive customer experience. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of our systems and infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Build SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs: Partner with development and business teams to define indicators and objectives that reflect real customer experience Incident Response: Lead through complex incidents and continuously improve how quickly we detect, diagnose, and resolve issues — sharpening alerting, tooling, and on-call practices to shorten MTTD and MTTR over time. Evolve Monitoring and Observability Stack: Consistently improve the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) with a customer-centric lens leading our operations to be more effective Drive RCAs and Postmortems: Run blameless root cause analyses and postmortems that turn incidents into durable improvements, closing the developer and operations loop High Availability & Performance: Ensure platform availability and responsiveness meet customer expectations. Identify and remove performance bottlenecks before they impact customer AI for Operations: Apply AI/LLM capabilities to incident triage, log/trace analysis, runbook execution, and anomaly detection to shorten MTTR and reduce on-call load. Optimization for Cost: Right-size workloads, eliminate waste, and design for cost-efficient scaling across our cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and container infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes). Toil Reduction: Build automated processes to reduce toil within SRE, such as remediation for known failure modes so the platform heals itself where possible, escalating to humans only when judgement is genuinely required. Architectural Oversight: Participate in architectural design and decision-making processes, ensuring that design choices align with organizational goals and best practices. What Success Looks Like High-Signal Alerting: Alerts are accurate and actionable — when something fires, it matters, and the team trusts it. Noise is actively driven down rather than tolerated. Fewer Production Incidents: The number and severity of customer-impacting incidents trend down over time, as recurring failure modes are addressed at the root rather than worked around. Tight Product–SRE Feedback Loop: Continuous, two-way feedback between product engineering and SRE — reliability concerns shape what gets built, and operational learnings flow back into product decisions. Reduced Toil: Engineers spend less time on repetitive operational work and more time on improvements that compound — measured by what gets automated, eliminated, or self-healed away. Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Experience:5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or related fields, with at least 2 years in a leadership or mentoring role. Cloud Technologies: Deep understanding of cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP) and hands-on experience with cloud architecture. Architectural Design: Proven experience in providing architectural oversight, with a strong ability to make informed decisions that drive system performance and scalability. Containerization: Proven experience with container orchestration platforms, particularly Kubernetes. Scripting: Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python or Bash. Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and the Grafana stack. Automation Tools: Experience with automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Chef. Soft Skills: Strong leadership qualities, excellent communication skills, and a collaborative mindset. Preferred Qualifications Experience with CI/CD pipelines and relevant tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.). Kubernetes certification (CKA, CKAD) and/or cloud certifications (Azure, AWS, GCP) are highly desirable. Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards in cloud environments. Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools.

new_matches.title: Financial Controller
new_matches.description: Who We Are: Some of the companies under our stable include Private Equity (licensed by the Securities Commission), Digital Marketing, Recruitment, Esports, Event Management and Consultancy. We care about understanding things for what they are, and not what they appear to be. We know we will not always make the right decisions, but we put in the effort to make our decisions right. We value people who are curious, disciplined, and open to learning. We care about doing things properly, even when it takes time. Our companies follow the same principle: practical, thoughtful, and built for people who appreciate steady, honest work. Role Overview: You will own the numbers across a portfolio of companies operating in Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia, and you will lead a finance team of seven. This is a build role before it is a maintenance role. The team is new. The systems are not yet in place. Your first year is about putting them there: one standard chart of accounts across every entity, a close calendar that actually holds, a review process that catches errors before they travel upward, and consolidated numbers that arrive on time and can be relied upon. If you are looking for a seat where the structure already exists and the job is to keep it running, this is not that role. If you have wanted to design a finance function properly rather than inherit somebody else's compromises, and you are comfortable working in ambiguity while you do it, this is that role. You will report directly to our CEO, with nobody in between. Your Team: You will have a team of seven: three Senior Finance Executives, two Finance Executives, and two interns. This being a new role in an expanding organization, 4 of your reports arrive without a long track record. Teaching is therefore not a side duty in this role. It is half of it. What You Will Do: 1) Team leadership and technical development. Lead, teach and develop a team of seven across three levels of experience. Review your team's work technically, not only for completeness. You are the reason errors stop travelling upward. Build the training path that takes fresh graduates and interns to competence, and set the standard for documentation, self-checking and knowing when to escalate versus when to decide. 2) Financial reporting, close and consolidation. Own timely and accurate monthly and annual closings across your portfolio of entities. Deliver consolidation and management accounts, including intercompany eliminations and a documented shared-services allocation methodology. Build and hold a close calendar with named owners and committed dates, and design a documented, repeatable consolidation process. 3) Financial operations and internal controls. Manage daily finance operations including treasury, banking, working capital and cash visibility. Design and enforce internal controls: segregation of duties, approval thresholds, bank authorization, and a formal review step inside the team. Standardize the chart of accounts and reconciliation discipline across entities. 4) Compliance and statutory reporting. Liaise with auditors, corporate secretaries and tax agents across Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia so that statutory reporting is complete and on time. Bring audit file preparation in-house, so that auditors audit rather than prepare. Maintain a master statutory calendar built backward from every deadline with realistic lead times. Document and execute intercompany and transfer pricing positions, and support regulatory reporting for our licensed entity alongside compliance and external counsel. Retain oversight of payroll across jurisdictions, including our outsourced Indonesian provider. 5) From year two. The role broadens into financial planning and analysis, budgeting and decision support as the build work completes. Ad hoc assignments, special projects and business presentations as required. Who You Are: A Bachelor's Degree, Post-Graduate Diploma or Professional Degree in Finance, Accountancy or Banking. A professional qualification (ACCA, CIMA, CPA or MIA). Finalists will be considered where the remaining papers and dates are clear. Minimum 8 years of relevant experience. Full ownership of month-end close and a complete set of accounts across more than one entity. Single-entity experience will not be sufficient for this role. Demonstrated people management, including at least one concrete example of reviewing another person's work technically rather than only allocating it. Fluency in a cloud accounting platform. Advanced Excel, including multi-entity consolidation modelling. Statutory reporting and audit liaison experience, having prepared rather than only responded. Working knowledge of Malaysian indirect tax and withholding tax, with the instinct to recognise when a tax question exists. Proficient in verbal and written English. Bahasa Malaysia is preferred. Highly detail oriented, with the time management to hold several close deadlines at once. Extra Credits: Experience with Xero specifically. A shared services or outsourced accounting background, servicing multiple entities or clients. Experience designing or rebuilding a chart of accounts, or cleaning up a set of books that had drifted. Intercompany reconciliation and transfer pricing documentation exposure. Multi-jurisdiction experience, particularly Singapore or Indonesia. Exposure to regulated financial environments such as capital markets, funds or professional services. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, strong interpersonal and communication skills, comfort working both in a team and independently, and adaptability to tight deadlines. What kind of culture should I expect?: A fun and enjoyable working environment that values humility, a positive attitude, teamwork and creativity, alongside a strong desire for growth and learning. Our team is comfortable being called out if something does not meet standards, with little offence taken personally. Our progressive management initiates self-evaluation exercises, culture days, team alignment sessions and town halls. We appreciate guidance and mentorship, and actively foster a supportive environment for our team to grow and develop their skills and expertise. We enjoy free parking, pantry restocks, regular team-building activities and company trips, amongst others. What should I expect from work?: You will be working directly with our CEO, an award-winning entrepreneur who will be personally involved in mentoring and guiding you. You will be given real responsibility from day one in a fast-growing company. Expect a steep learning curve and to be challenged to bring out your best. You will enjoy this role if you take satisfaction in a backend function that is genuinely load-bearing, and in building something that outlasts your own involvement in it. The Details: Salary : RM12,000 to RM15,000 per month. Employment type : Permanent, full time. Location : Fully on site. We are currently in Bukit Tunku, Kuala Lumpur, and will be relocating to Pavilion Damansara Heights Corporate Tower in a few months. Start date : As soon as you are available. Note: We receive more than 2,000 CVs on a monthly basis, and we might potentially miss out on some good candidates. If you think that you fit into the role described, please resubmit your application with us. We celebrate persistence!
